szoveg_eredeti:
UNDP and the Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan Strengthen Partnerships in Artificial Intelligence and Innovation

Ashgabat, 26 November 2026 – The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in partnership with the Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan, held the AI & Innovation Dialogue 2026: From Pilots to Partnerships – UNDP. Hosted at the Ish Nokady coworking centre in Ashgabat, the event brought together representatives of government institutions, the private sector, international organizations, technology companies and the startup community to exchange experiences and discuss the practical application and scaling up of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, as well as opportunities for regional cooperation.

During the discussions, participants from Central Asia and other regions explored opportunities and barriers to AI adoption, the transition from pilot initiatives to practical implementation, the role of public-private collaboration and the development of startup ecosystems. Attention was given to attracting venture capital, strengthening innovation infrastructure and human capacities, and fostering cross-border partnerships.

The programme featured a startup exhibition and panel discussions with representatives of technology companies, innovation hubs and startups. Participants also explored opportunities for joint initiatives and partnerships to introduce and scale up innovative solutions.

“Unlocking the potential of artificial intelligence requires bringing together the efforts of government institutions, businesses and the innovation community, while creating an enabling environment for practical solutions and their scaling up. Regional cooperation and knowledge exchange help combine expertise and entrepreneurial potential, turning innovation into tangible opportunities for economic development and improved quality of life,” said Narine Sahakyan, UNDP Resident Representative in Turkmenistan.

The Dialogue helped strengthen engagement among government institutions, technology businesses, investors and the innovation community, opening new opportunities for cooperation in artificial intelligence and digital innovation.

UNDP continues to support Turkmenistan in advancing digital transformation, strengthening national capacities in artificial intelligence and fostering partnerships to build an inclusive innovation ecosystem aligned with national priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals.
